description:
Universidad Europea de Madrid (UEM) is one of Spain’s most prestigious private universities, known for its global approach to higher education and a strong focus on innovation, employability, and practical training. Located in Spain’s vibrant capital, the university offers a multicultural learning environment and is part of the prestigious Laureate International Universities network.

With over 16,000 students and a wide range of undergraduate, graduate, and professional programs taught in both English and Spanish, Universidad Europea is especially popular among international students aiming for a career in global business, health sciences, engineering, or communication. The institution prioritizes hands-on learning, with over 100 partnerships with international companies and organizations for internships and real-world experience.
